$comment: Future Ready Group System: every fixed value list the screens may show or send. Source: live database (26 Oct 2026) and app/outbox.js, app/status.js. Changing any list here needs a database migration first.

meaning.direct: table write outside both (should not occur after Stage 9)
meaning.service: server process with no signed-in user (backups, triggers run by the system)

save_results.$comment: What one save returns. QUEUED is client-side only: the change is on this device and has not reached the database.

meaning.APPLIED: Saved in the database. Screen may say 'Saved'.
meaning.DUPLICATE: The database already had this exact change (same operation id). Treat as saved; show the returned row.
meaning.CONFLICT: Someone else changed the same field since this screen loaded. Non-clashing fields were saved; the clashing value waits in Conflicts for a Group Admin.
meaning.REFUSED: Not allowed or not valid. Nothing saved. Show the message; do not retry automatically.
meaning.FAILED: The database could not be reached or answered with an error. Nothing saved unless it was queued.
meaning.QUEUED: Saved on this device. Waiting to synchronize. Never say 'Saved'.

meaning.waiting: On this device, not yet sent.
meaning.sending: Being sent now (claimed by one tab).
meaning.applied: Reached the database; removed from the outbox.
meaning.conflict: Reached the database with a clash; kept until the person dismisses it.
meaning.refused: The database said no; kept with the reason until dismissed.
meaning.failed: Five non-network errors in a row; kept with 'Try again'.

retry: every 30 seconds while anything is waiting

meaning.LIVE: The database answers normally, live updates are connected and nothing on this device is waiting.
meaning.DEGRADED: The device is online but something is wrong: the database cannot be reached, returned server errors in the last 2 minutes, or answers slowly (median over 4 s); the sign-in service is failing; live updates have been disconnected for over 20 s; or changes on this device are waiting or need attention. The panel shows the data-on-screen time, waiting count, last successful backup and what is unavailable.
meaning.OFFLINE: The device itself reports no connection (navigator.onLine is false). Queue-safe changes are kept on the device; everything else says nothing was saved.

never_queued_offline.$comment: Source: NEVER_OFFLINE and refuse() in app/outbox.js. These say 'nothing was saved' instead of queuing.
changes: any change that sets stage or status to 'cancelled'
any action other than insert/update/save (soft_delete, restore, purge)
not_records: named functions: next_number (job, quote, receipt numbers), leave_decide, request_to_quote, member/company administration, settings, sign-in
never_queued_offline.note: A new job needs next_number from the database first, so new numbered jobs cannot be created offline.
